title: 「Per se 句：表達『本身／就其本身而言』」
titleZh: 「Per se 句：表達『本身／就其本身而言』」
titleEn: Using per se to distinguish a thing itself from its context

source.file: Sentence Structure 124 - 「Per se 句：表達『本身／就其本身而言』」.pdf
omissions: English versions of Chinese-only Important Rules and Benefits headings are faithful editorial translations.

formula: Subject + be + not + adjective / noun phrase + per se; + the real issue or qualification

formulas.formula: Subject + be + not + adjective / noun phrase + per se; + the real issue or qualification
Subject + do / does / did + not + verb + object + per se; + qualification
Subject + be + adjective / noun phrase + per se, but + limitation

example: Coffee is not bad per se; drinking too much of it is.
exampleZh: 咖啡本身並沒有不好；喝太多才是問題。

examples.en: Coffee is not bad per se; drinking too much of it is.
examples.zh: 咖啡本身並沒有不好；喝太多才是問題。

examples.en: Memorisation is not harmful per se, but relying on it alone can be limiting.
examples.zh: 死記硬背本身並沒有害處，但只依賴它可能會有局限。

examples.en: Working overtime is not the problem per se; poor planning is.
examples.zh: 加班本身不是問題；規劃不善才是。

examples.en: Artificial intelligence is not dangerous per se; how people use it matters more.
examples.zh: 人工智能本身並不危險；更重要的是人們如何使用它。

rules.zh: 通常放在被限定的詞語或意思之後
rules.en: Place per se after the word or idea whose scope it limits.
examples: Coffee is not unhealthy per se.

rules.zh: 最常見的形式是 not … per se 這個句式不是說某件事完全沒有問題，而是指出「問題不在事物本身」。
rules.en: The most common pattern is not ... per se. It does not claim that there is no problem at all; it says that the problem does not lie in the thing itself.

rules.zh: 後面常用 but 或分號補充真正問題
rules.en: A but-clause or semicolon often introduces the real issue.
examples: The rule is not unfair per se, but its application may be inconsistent.

rules.zh: per se 與 in itself、by itself 意思相近 Per se 通常較精簡，語氣亦稍為正式，常見於作文、討論、報告及分析性說話。
rules.en: Per se is close in meaning to in itself or by itself. It is usually more concise and slightly formal, and is common in essays, discussions, reports and analytical speech.

rules.zh: 必須寫成兩個字：per se 不要寫成 per say，亦不要加連字號。
rules.en: Write per se as two words; do not write per say or hyphenate it.

rules.zh: 本練習集中訓練平衡評價 答案主要使用 not … per se，再指出真正原因、限制、使用方式或後果。
rules.en: This lesson focuses on balanced evaluation. Answers mainly use not ... per se and then identify the true cause, limitation, manner of use or consequence.

benefits.zh: 這個句型能避免你把事情說得過分絕對。你可以指出某件事本身未必好或壞，真正情況要視乎其 他因素。
benefits.en: It helps you avoid overgeneralising. This structure lets you explain that something is not automatically good, bad, safe or harmful simply because it exists; whether it is good or bad may depend on other factors.

benefits.zh: 你可以把事物本身與錯誤使用、過量使用、設計不良或有害後果分開。
benefits.en: It separates the thing from the real problem. You can distinguish an object, idea or activity from its misuse, excessive use, poor design or harmful effects.

benefits.zh: 你不需要直接說「科技有害」，而可以更準確地說明真正造成問題的是甚麼。
benefits.en: It makes opinions more balanced and precise. Instead of simply claiming that technology is harmful, you can identify more accurately what is actually causing the problem.

benefits.zh: 句子前半部分先否定過分簡單的說法，後半部分再提出更重要的解釋，特別適合作文和討論。
benefits.en: It helps you develop an argument. The first part rejects an oversimplified claim, while the second introduces the more important explanation, making the structure especially useful in essays and discussions.

benefits.zh: 相比反覆使用較長的說法，per se 能更簡潔地表達「就事情本身而言」。
benefits.en: It gives you a concise alternative to longer expressions. Instead of repeatedly writing in and of itself or when considered alone, you can often use per se.

questions.answer: Innovation is not improvement per se; a new system can be more complicated without being more useful.
questions.answerZh: 創新本身並不等於改善；新制度可以更加複雜，卻不一定更加有用。
questions.highlight: Innovation is not improvement per se; a new system can be more complicated without being more useful.

questions.prompt: Transparency alone is not the same as trust, but it gives people evidence on which trust can be built.
questions.promptZh: 透明度本身不等於信任，但它能提供建立信任所需的證據。
questions.answer: Transparency is not trust per se, but it gives people evidence on which trust can be built.

questions.prompt: A policy is not automatically effective merely because it sounds strict; its results must be measured in practice.
questions.promptZh: 一項政策不會只因聽起來嚴厲就自然有效；其成效必須在實際情況中量度。
questions.answer: A strict-sounding policy is not effective per se; its results must be measured in practice.
questions.answerZh: 一項聽起來嚴厲的政策本身不一定有效；其成效必須在實際情況中量度。
questions.highlight: A strict-sounding policy is not effective per se; its results must be measured in practice.

questions.prompt: Freedom does not simply mean having no rules; well-designed rules can protect everyone’s ability to act.
questions.promptZh: 自由不只是沒有規則；設計良好的規則可以保障每個人的行動能力。
questions.answer: Freedom is not the absence of rules per se; well-designed rules can protect everyone’s ability to act.
questions.answerZh: 自由本身並不等於沒有規則；設計良好的規則可以保障每個人的行動能力。
questions.highlight: Freedom is not the absence of rules per se; well-designed rules can protect everyone’s ability to act.

questions.prompt: A high salary alone does not amount to job satisfaction; autonomy, purpose, and respectful management also matter.

questions.prompt: Globalisation does not automatically cause cultural loss; loss occurs when local voices have no power or space.
questions.promptZh: 全球化不會自動造成文化流失；當本地聲音沒有權力或空間時，文化才會流失。
questions.answer: Globalisation is not cultural loss per se; loss occurs when local voices have no power or space.
